```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

Load important libraries
```
library(albedofindr)
library(rgee)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(stars)
library(geojsonio)
library(glue)
library(here)
```

```{r discrete-library, echo = FALSE}
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rgee)
```


Initialize Earth Engine
```
rgee::ee_Authenticate(user = "your-username@gmail.com", auth_mode = "notebook")
rgee::ee_Initialize(
  user = "your-username@gmail.com",
  drive = TRUE,
  project = "your-project"
)
```

Locally save geometry of area of interest (AOI)
```
aoi <- sf_as_ee(sample_polygon_1995["geometry"])
aoi_geometry <- aoi$geometry()$bounds()
```

Use albedofindr package to get a median albedo composite (2 years postfire) across AOI for specified time period
```
# 1997, two years post fire
median_albedo <- get_median_albedo(
  year = 1997,
  start_month = "July",
  start_day = 1,
  end_month = "September",
  end_day = 1,
  aoi = aoi_geometry
  )
```

Export median albedo composite as a Google Earth Engine asset 
```
task <- ee$batch$Export$image$toAsset(
    image = median_albedo,
    description = "test_median_1995fireyear_1997albedo",
    assetId = "projects/your-project/assets/test_median_1995fireyear_1997albedo",
    region = aoi_geometry,
    scale = 300,
    maxPixels = 1e13
  )

task$start()
```

Once uploaded as asset, extract locally 
```
median_albedo_asset <- ee$Image("projects/your-project/assets/test_median_1995fireyear_1997albedo")

ee_as_raster(
  image = median_albedo_asset,
  region = aoi_geometry,
  scale = 300,
  dsn = "median_albedo_1995fireyear_1997img.tif"
)
```

Plot raster
```{r plotdata}

median_1995 <- system.file("extdata", "median_albedo_1995fireyear_1997img.tif", package = "albedofindr")

sample_polygon_1995 <- system.file("extdata", "simplified_polygon_1995.shp", package = "albedofindr")

albedo_raster <- rast(median_1995)

aoi_sf <- st_read(sample_polygon_1995)
aoi_vector <- vect(aoi_sf)

albedo_cropped <- crop(albedo_raster, aoi_vector)
albedo_masked <- mask(albedo_cropped, aoi_vector)
plot(albedo_masked)
```
